note: stop: the most the M6 ledger may ever hold in credits (the Starter account has 40000). max_call: no single call may cost more (a 30 s bed is 1200 at 40 credits a second). credits_per_second: the rate used to project a call before it runs (docs say 40, measured 10 on 2026-11-04: 15 credits for 1.5 s of v3 output, see M6-calls/AUDIO.md); the tool measures the real cost of every call from /v1/user/subscription and writes it to the ledger.
